businessSummary.S: BEST S.A. is one of the largest debt collection and debt management companies in Poland, serving as the parent of the BEST Group, which actively invests in non-performing debt portfolios. The company provides debt collection services for banks and other financial institutions, manages securitization funds, and holds a license from the Polish Financial Supervision Authority (KNF) to manage securitized assets. Since 2011, BEST has been an active issuer on the Catalyst corporate bond market, regularly conducting public bond offerings for both institutional and retail investors.

Europejski Bank Inwestycyjny (European Investment Bank, EIB) is the European Union's development bank, established in 1958 under the Treaty of Rome and jointly owned by all EU member states. It raises funds on capital markets and lends them on favorable terms to projects supporting EU policy objectives, including infrastructure, energy transition, innovation, and SME financing. The EIB is active in Poland's Catalyst bond market, where it lists PLN-denominated bonds, and has invested a record €8 billion in Poland in 2025 alone.

mBank Hipoteczny S.A. is the oldest and largest specialist mortgage bank in Poland, operating as a subsidiary of mBank Group. Its primary business activity is issuing covered bonds (both mortgage and public sector) on domestic and international capital markets, including the Catalyst market of the Warsaw Stock Exchange and the Luxembourg Stock Exchange. The bank also provides mortgage loans for residential and commercial real estate to individual clients, small and medium-sized enterprises, and the public sector.

Miasto Siedlce (City of Siedlce) is a Polish local government unit and the capital of Eastern Mazovia, responsible for public administration, urban infrastructure, education, and social services for its residents. As a municipal entity, it finances public investments by issuing bonds on the Catalyst bond market. Its official portal serves as the primary communication channel between the city authorities and citizens.

PCC Rokita S.A. is one of the leading chemical companies in Poland, headquartered in Brzeg Dolny, Lower Silesia, with over 60 years of tradition. The company manufactures a broad range of industrial chemicals, with its main product groups including chlorine and alkali (produced via modern membrane electrolysis), polyols, and naphthalene and phosphorus derivatives. It operates as the parent company of a Capital Group and is a subsidiary of the German conglomerate PCC SE.

Pekao Bank Hipoteczny S.A. is a specialized mortgage bank and a member of the Pekao Group, one of Central and Eastern Europe's largest financial institutions. Its primary activities include providing long-term real estate financing — such as mortgage loans for housing and the public sector — and issuing covered bonds (listy zastawne) secured by mortgage loans, which are among the world's safest financial instruments. The bank serves as a key vehicle for channeling capital market funds into real estate financing within the Pekao Group.

Skarb Państwa (the State Treasury of the Republic of Poland) is the sovereign entity representing the Polish state in financial and legal matters. Acting through the Minister of Finance, it issues Polish Treasury bonds (T-bonds and T-bills) on both domestic markets — including the Catalyst bond market — and international markets, financing the country's public debt. It is the largest and most prominent bond issuer in Poland.
